title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30292: add temporary Warehouse Activity Line parameter to OnBeforeCreateWhseActivHeader
summary: The OnBeforeCreateWhseActivHeader event in the Create Pick codeunit now includes a temporary Warehouse Activity Line parameter, allowing subscribers to inspect pick lines before a warehouse activity header is created.
key_points: Added temporary Warehouse Activity Line parameter to OnBeforeCreateWhseActivHeader event
Enables subscribers to inspect pick lines before header creation
Allows decision logic for routing lines to new or existing pick headers
Parameter is trailing so existing subscribers remain compatible
Supports complex scenarios with Sales, Transfer, and Purchase Return Orders
